title: Ezra gathers the Levites and travels to Jerusalem
description: Ezra gathers the people at the River Ahava, discovers that there are no Levites, and sends messengers to Iddo in Casiphia to bring servants for the house of God. He proclaims a fast to seek God's protection on the journey, then weighs out silver, gold, and holy vessels which he entrusts to priests and Levites. On the twelfth day of the first month they set out from the River Ahava, and God protects them from enemies along the way. Upon arriving in Jerusalem, the treasures are weighed in the temple, and the returning exiles offer burnt offerings to the Lord.
